title: COMMON LOOP — Repairable knitwear for autumn and winter, 14 deliverables

# COMMON LOOP

## Collection
- Season: autumn and winter.
- Audience: adults moving between home, work and everyday travel.
- Identity continuity: attached Navy, Rust and Cream swatches; relaxed layered proportions from last-season-1.png.
- Collection name: COMMON LOOP.
- Back-neck label second line: Made to be mended.
- Label position: inside centre back neck of P01, C01 and V01.
- Label dimensions: 75 × 20 mm.
- Label layout: collection name on line 1; second line beneath.

## Materials
| ID | Composition | Structure | Weight | Usable width | Finish | Application |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| M01 | 80% wool, 20% nylon | 12-gauge double moss stitch; 8 × 8 mm repeat | 380 g/m² | 1400 mm | Washed, unbrushed | Garment bodies, sleeves and elbow patches |
| M02 | 80% wool, 20% nylon | 12-gauge 2 × 2 rib | 420 g/m² | 1000 mm | Washed, unbrushed | Cuffs, neckline bands, hem bands and cardigan opening bands |

## Colours and styles
| Style ID | Name | Body and rib colour | Elbow patch colour | Materials | Closure |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| P01 | Pullover | Rust #9B513D | Cream #E6DDCA | M01, M02 | Pullover opening |
| C01 | Cardigan | Navy #253544 | Rust #9B513D | M01, M02 | Five 18 mm corozo buttons |
| V01 | Vest | Cream #E6DDCA | Not applicable | M01, M02 | Pullover opening |

## Construction and repair
- Body and sleeve seams: linked seams using matching yarn.
- P01 and C01 cuffs: replaceable M02 rib, matching body colour.
- Cuff connection: removable hand linking around the full joining circumference, with the linking-yarn ends accessible inside the sleeve seam.
- Cuff depth: 60 mm in S, M and L.
- Cuff joining circumferences, relaxed: S 220 mm; M 240 mm; L 260 mm.
- Elbow patch quantity: two per P01 and two per C01; one per sleeve.
- Elbow patch material: M01.
- Elbow patch shape and orientation: rectangle, 80 mm across sleeve and 100 mm along sleeve.
- Elbow patch centre: back sleeve centreline, 180 mm above the cuff joining seam in all sizes.
- Patch attachment: removable running stitches through patch and sleeve.
- Patch stitch direction: vertical, parallel to sleeve length.
- Patch stitch geometry: 5 mm stitch, 5 mm gap, 10 mm between rows, 5 mm inset from patch edges.
- Patch stitch yarn colour: Navy #253544 on both Cream and Rust patches.
- Remaining neckline shapes, hem details and pocket arrangements: open style details.

## Finished garment measurements
- Units: mm.
- Measurement state: relaxed, laid flat; chest and cuff values expressed as full circumferences.
- Body length: high shoulder point to bottom hem.
- Sleeve length: underarm seam to cuff joining seam; cuff depth recorded separately.

| Style ID | Size | Chest circumference | Body length | Underarm sleeve length | Cuff joining circumference | Cuff depth |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| P01 | S | 1040 | 620 | 460 | 220 | 60 |
| P01 | M | 1120 | 640 | 480 | 240 | 60 |
| P01 | L | 1200 | 660 | 500 | 260 | 60 |
| C01 | S | 1200 | 700 | 440 | 220 | 60 |
| C01 | M | 1280 | 720 | 460 | 240 | 60 |
| C01 | L | 1360 | 740 | 480 | 260 | 60 |
| V01 | S | 1120 | 650 | Not applicable | Not applicable | Not applicable |
| V01 | M | 1200 | 670 | Not applicable | Not applicable | Not applicable |
| V01 | L | 1280 | 690 | Not applicable | Not applicable | Not applicable |

## Grade increments
- S to M and M to L, all styles: chest circumference +80 mm; body length +20 mm.
- S to M and M to L, P01 and C01: underarm sleeve length +20 mm; cuff joining circumference +20 mm.
- All sizes: patch dimensions 80 × 100 mm; patch centre 180 mm above cuff seam; cuff depth 60 mm.

## Wearing combinations
| ID | Setting | Clothing and state |
| --- | --- | --- |
| W01 | Home | P01, seated |
| W02 | Office | P01 beneath V01 beneath open C01; three distinct neckline or opening shapes visible |
| W03 | Everyday journey | P01 beneath closed C01, walking |
| W04 | Home | C01 worn over a plain base layer |
| W05 | Everyday journey | W03 with C01 removed and carried; P01 exposed |
| W06 | Office | V01 over a plain base layer |

## Movement sequence
- Duration: 12 seconds.
- Combination: W02.
- Actions: standing; reaching for a desk item; walking.
- Closing names: COMMON LOOP, P01, C01, V01.

steps.userMessage:
COMMON LOOP | Repairable knitwear for autumn and winter

We are developing COMMON LOOP for adults moving between home, work and everyday travel. The collection has three fixed styles: P01 Pullover in Rust #9B513D, C01 Cardigan in Navy #253544 and V01 Vest in Cream #E6DDCA. Develop these as a coordinated autumn and winter wardrobe, carrying forward the attached yarn colours and the relaxed proportions of our previous collection. The cardigan has five 18 mm corozo buttons. Our office combination is P01 under V01 under an open C01; the pullover neckline, vest neckline and cardigan opening must each remain visible. The fabric family is fixed: M01 is 80% wool, 20% nylon, 12-gauge double moss stitch, 380 g/m², with an 8 × 8 mm texture repeat and 1400 mm usable width; M02 is the same composition in 12-gauge 2 × 2 rib, 420 g/m², with 1000 mm usable width. Both have a washed, unbrushed finish. P01 and C01 have replaceable M02 cuffs, 60 mm deep, joined by removable hand linking. Their relaxed joining circumferences are 220 mm in S, 240 mm in M and 260 mm in L. Each sleeve carries an external M01 elbow patch, 80 × 100 mm, centred on the back sleeve line 180 mm above the cuff joining seam. P01 patches are Cream; C01 patches are Rust. Patch stitching runs vertically: 5 mm stitches, 5 mm gaps, rows 10 mm apart and a 5 mm edge inset. The attached size records fix the garment measurements. Each style carries a 75 × 20 mm inside back-neck label printed with "COMMON LOOP" and "Made to be mended" on separate lines. Detail the remaining neckline, hem and pocket choices as one coherent family.

Audience: our clothing design team, knitwear workshop and retail team, for the collection selection and sampling brief.

Inputs (attached): 01-client-facts.en.md contains the material, style, size and repair records. 02-delivery-catalog.en.md lists each deliverable's proportion, format and stage. knit-repair-geometry.png is the constraint drawing for garment measurements, patch placement, cuff interfaces and the texture repeat. swatch-1.png is the identity reference for Navy yarn colour and surface character. swatch-2.png is the identity reference for Rust yarn colour and surface character. swatch-3.png is the identity reference for Cream yarn colour and surface character. last-season-1.png is the identity reference for continuity with our existing layered clothing. home-window.png provides reference atmosphere for the home wearing images. shared-office.png provides reference atmosphere for the office wearing images.

Deliverables:
1. A fabric and craft sheet, one document establishing M01 and M02 composition, weight, usable width, knit structure and finish, the three style IDs and colours, size-M garment measurements, patch placement and stitching, cuff joining method, label wording and five 18 mm corozo buttons
2. Four flat-lay images: collection front and collection back showing P01, C01 and V01 in size M, plus separate enlarged P01 front and back views, with label enlargements on the collection front
3. Three wearing images: P01 seated at home, P01 under V01 under an open C01 at the office, and P01 under a closed C01 walking on an everyday journey
4. Two repair detail images of the same P01 elbow, one with the Cream patch attached and one with the patch removed beside its exposed attachment area, with patch and stitch dimensions
5. Two colour and material images, one family palette linking all three styles to M01 and M02 and one enlarged M01 texture study with its 8 × 8 mm repeat
6. One 12-second movement video showing the office combination standing, reaching for a desk item and walking, with a readable closing frame naming COMMON LOOP, P01, C01 and V01
7. A collection presentation, at least eight pages, reusing the fabric and craft sheet, flat-lays, wearing images, repair details, palette and texture study, plus three stills from the movement video

Acceptance:
- Establish M01, M02, P01, C01, V01 and COMMON LOOP in the fabric and craft sheet first; repeat the applicable material and style IDs on every flat-lay, repair detail and material image, and repeat the complete set in the presentation.
- Repeat the fabric and craft sheet's size-M chest circumference and body length on the collection flat-lays and in the presentation: P01 1120 mm and 640 mm, C01 1280 mm and 720 mm, V01 1200 mm and 670 mm; repeat the P01 and C01 cuff dimensions of 240 mm joining circumference and 60 mm depth on their flat-lays.
- Show Rust P01, Navy C01 and Cream V01 consistently in the flat-lays, wearing images, palette, video and presentation; show five 18 mm buttons on C01's front flat-lay, and print COMMON LOOP and Made to be mended legibly in each of the three label enlargements and on the presentation's label page.
- Match the 8 × 8 mm M01 repeat between the texture study, flat-lays, repair details and visible garment surfaces in the wearing images and video; label the 80 × 100 mm patches and their centres 180 mm above the cuff seam on the back flat-lays and repeat both dimensions in the presentation.
- Match the same P01 sleeve in both repair details, showing the Cream patch attached and removed; label vertical 5 mm stitches, 5 mm gaps, 10 mm row spacing and 5 mm edge inset on the attached detail and repeat these values in the fabric and craft sheet and presentation.
- Supply the three named wearing situations, retain all three visible neckline or opening shapes in the office image and office video, and show at least one Cream P01 patch and one Rust C01 patch in that image; deliver a 12-second video with the four closing names and a presentation of at least eight pages containing three video stills.

Please clearly mark which version you consider the final deliverable. If nothing is marked, the last exported version counts.
